scope: End-to-end FCO / Fe / Sonatina dependency structure distilled from bundle discussion
principles: Milestone names are release-cut views, not dependency authorities.
Nodes represent capabilities, invariants, tests, decisions, or uncertain zones.
Hard edges participate in topological sort; soft edges mark uncertainty/clarification overlays.
Every status must be audited against the current repo before implementation.
This graph is deliberately status-light: it is a draft dependency structure, not a completion report.

edge_kinds.soft: Uncertainty or clarification edge; useful for planning but not a topo-sort blocker.

nodes.title: CTFE discharge outside trait solver

nodes.title: Paired correctness fixture suite

nodes.title: WhereClauseOwner coverage

nodes.title: ADT/signature/WF const-predicate discharge

nodes.title: WF evidence origins

nodes.title: WF duplicate diagnostic guard

nodes.title: Generic symbolic WF guard

nodes.title: Never-called declaration/signature coverage

nodes.title: No splitting / flipping / implication tests

nodes.title: Impl where const predicates represented

nodes.title: Trait solver residual predicate carry

nodes.title: Gate-not-select semantics

nodes.title: B2b overlap/coherence fixture

nodes.title: Selected impl predicate fault hard error

nodes.title: False predicate diagnostic

nodes.title: Formation / availability diagnostic

nodes.title: Unsupported projection/expression named limitation

nodes.title: CTFE fault diagnostic

items: PrimTy is the WRONG vehicle: PrimTy = 4 runtime variants (Bool/Int/Uint/String) matched in ~220 codegen/mir/abi sites; capabilities are compile-time-ONLY, so PrimTy-izing Reflect/ImplBuilder/Evidence/Quote (the effort2 route) breaks dozens of exhaustive matches AND is a semantic misfit (runtime lowering of non-runtime types).

Recognition is at LOWERING, not type-check: provider.rs reads the `uses` param's path head-ident (REFLECT_KEY/IMPL_BUILDER_KEY) during HIR construction, before name resolution. So 'typed recognition' is a recognition-STAGE change (resolve the capability path to a definition, or move recognition past name-res) — not a string→type compare swap.

Recommended fco-native K04a: capabilities as resolved-type identities (e.g. opaque builtin/std types recognized by ADT identity), NOT PrimTy; rewire provider.rs recognition off the string keys.
